description: This Java class 'ConfigDefinition' is responsible for reading, parsing, and generating configuration-related files within a software project. It handles processing of configuration definitions, generating C headers, TypeScript, and Java field definitions, and managing templates. The class contains logic for interpreting structure definitions, constants, and custom lines, as well as invoking consumers to handle output for different target formats.

classes.name: ConfigDefinition
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing configuration files, generating code snippets, and managing the configuration processing workflow.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the processing by reading input arguments, opening files, and orchestrating the parsing workflow.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads each line from the configuration definition file and dispatches it for processing based on line content.

methods.name: handleCustomLine
methods.description: Processes custom configuration lines, extracting name, size, and associated tutor studio lines, and updates internal state.

methods.name: handleBitLine
methods.description: Processes 'bit' definitions, creating bit fields and adding them to the current structure context.

methods.name: startsWithToken
methods.description: Utility to check if a line begins with a specific token, accommodating tab or space separation.

methods.name: handleStartStructure
methods.description: Handles lines indicating the start of a new structure, creating a new ConfigStructure and pushing it onto the state stack.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Closes the current structure context, finalizes it, and passes it to output consumers.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Parses a line defining a configuration field and adds it to the current structure, handling array and iteration semantics.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Generates a formatted comment string with offset information.

methods.name: packComment
methods.description: Formats a multi-line comment into a C-style comment block.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size value for a given configuration parameter, either from a registry or by parsing directly.

methods.name: processDefine
methods.description: Parses a '#define' directive and registers the macro name and value.

methods.name: processTextTemplate
methods.description: Reads a template file, replaces variables, and writes the processed content to an output file.
